column2: Fall and you're DOWN. Hold to revive yourself by taking 1 HP from the frontmost surviving teammate (HP 2+). Ends when everyone is DOWN.
Fall and you're eliminated (no revives). The Reaper arrives at the HOST's set time or at 100,000m, whichever comes first. Ranked by distance reached; higher ranks earn a MILE bonus.
The Reaper appears at this time, even before 100,000m (or immediately upon reaching 100,000m, if first).
The Reaper is here! Race for distance until the end!
In VERSUS, you collect MILE earned before elimination plus bonuses only when the match ends. Leave early and you lose them.
